RVC Fabric user guide

Set up RVC Fabric to play music and sound effects while changing your voice in chat and games.

2026-11-07

Installation and first use

Download the installer from the official website. After installation, configure the runtime for your GPU and download or import a voice model. An internet connection is needed to download runtimes, models and updates. Once the required files are available, voice conversion runs locally. Check the license before using a third-party voice model.

System and hardware

The desktop application targets Windows 10 and Windows 11. NVIDIA GPUs use CUDA; AMD and Intel GPUs can use DirectML. Performance varies with the GPU, driver and model. Voice model training currently requires an NVIDIA GPU. Real-time latency depends on model inference, audio buffers, audio drivers and the receiving application. Check sound quality and stability through recording and an actual call after changing settings.

Connect voice chat, games and streams

In the audio device settings, select your physical microphone and set the output to CABLE Input. Set the microphone in QQ, Discord or your game to CABLE Output. In OBS, add an Audio Input Capture source and select CABLE Output. Use headphones for Windows playback and local monitoring.

  • VB-Cable documentation
  • OBS sources guide

Music, sound effects and voice changing

Open the audio library, import music or sound effects, and double-click an entry to play it into voice chat. To change your voice while playing music, select a voice model and start conversion. Both signals are mixed into the same output. Select headphones for local monitoring and enable music monitoring as needed. Assign global hotkeys to frequently used clips to play, pause and stop them while in a game.

Choosing an RVC tool

RVC is a voice conversion technology used by multiple applications. RVC Fabric provides a Windows desktop interface, runtime setup, model management and audio tools for users who need these functions in one application. Compare the supported operating systems, real-time and file conversion features, model formats and hardware requirements. Use the same audio and model to compare sound quality.

  • RVC WebUI repository
  • w-okada voice-changer repository

Neptune branch

The Neptune development branch also provides mobile pairing, a local API and an MCP interface. Audio captured on the phone is converted on the desktop.
